source.note: Captures Gemini 'systemInstruction' handling and generationConfig.temperature. The Go integration test feeds Path='/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent' with the inline JSON body containing systemInstruction.parts=[{text:'You are a helpful assistant.'}], contents=[{role:'user', parts:[{text:'What is the capital of France?'}]}], generationConfig.maxOutputTokens=2048, temperature=0.7. It asserts Model='gemini-2.5-flash', MaxTokens=2048, one user message, Stream=false, and the outbound URL 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent'. The response-side asserts mirror the simple case (synthesized ResponseID='test-response-123', text 'This is a test response from Gemini.', etc.). selected_channel is null.
